recipe.visualDefinition: A man in country attire stands inside a large, open-faced white cube situated in the middle of a vibrant green field under a blue sky. The interior back wall of the cube features expressive, black ink-style hand-lettering that interacts with the subject.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject leaning against the left interior wall of the white cube
Hand-lettered text occupying the right two-thirds of the back wall
Contrast between the clinical white geometry and the organic green landscape
Black ink texture against the flat white architectural surface
coreInvariants: The white cube must have visible depth and thickness
The landscape must be a saturated green field with a clear blue sky
The subject must wear a dark cowboy hat and casual denim/white tee attire

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is full-body, positioned on the far left of the frame, occupying approximately one-third of the cube's width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The white cube structure acts as the primary frame-within-a-frame anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the subject on the left, move right across the large gestural lettering, and then outward to the surrounding landscape.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: High negative space provided by the white interior walls and the expansive sky.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the landscape creates a surreal pop against the high-key white interior.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Expressive, gestural sans-serif with varying stroke widths
letterConstructionRules: Simulated wet brush strokes with visible bristles and splatter
Inconsistent x-height and baseline for a raw, handmade feel
Heavy ink saturation with dry-brush edges
characterSpecificRedesigns: Connected strokes in a faux-cursive style for specific words

composition.relationshipToImage: painted directly onto the set wall

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Raw, organic brushwork paired with a clean, geometric sans-serif inside a dark block.
graphicDevices: Faux-window cutout in the cube wall

preserve: The angled banner for the secondary text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the raw, energetic feel of the main title
Provides the necessary modern contrast for the secondary name

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A man in a white t-shirt, blue jeans, and a dark cowboy hat leaning against the left wall inside a large, open-fronted white wooden cube. The cube is placed in a bright green meadow under a clear blue sky with light clouds. The back wall of the cube is blank white.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply large, black, gestural hand-painted brushstroke lettering to the back wall of the cube. Add a small black rectangular banner at a slight upward angle in the top right corner with clean, white, wide-spaced uppercase sans-serif text inside it.

verificationChecks: Is the cube's perspective consistent with the landscape?
Does the lettering look like it was painted with a physical brush?
Is the man's pose relaxed and leaning?
Is the green of the grass highly saturated?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the artist
Any trademarked logos on the clothing
Exact wording of the original title

mustAchieve: Clean architectural lines for the cube
Authentic-looking paint texture for the text
avoid: Perfectly smooth digital fonts for the main title

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text does not overlap the subject
Check that the cube has a visible floor and ceiling
Verify the sky is bright blue, not overcast
Confirm the black banner is tilted correctly
recipe.reuseFormula: Place a [Subject Type] inside a [Geometric Structure] located in a [Vibrant Natural Setting], featuring [Expressive Hand-Painted Typography] on the interior walls to create a contrast between architecture and nature.
